summary: Azitra, Inc. filed a Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 on October 1, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing that its Phase 1/2 trial of ATR04-484 for EGFR inhibitor-associated skin rash completed Cohort 1 and, following a safety review committee clearance, will advance to Cohort 2. No transaction, securities offering, or corporate action is involved; the filing is a routine clinical-development update. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or risk-arb angle apply.
